summary: Always-visible list of selectable options (APG Listbox pattern). It is also the surface used by Select, Combobox and MultiSelect.
whenToUse: Choosing among options that must stay visible, for example in a side panel.
Options with a description or icon.
whenNotToUse: Navigation or actions: use NavigationMenu or DropdownMenu.
A few mutually exclusive options in a form: RadioGroup is simpler.

props.name: items
props.description: Dynamic collection with a render function as children.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Content when the collection is empty; default: localized “no options” message.

props.name: ListBoxItem: description / icon / isDisabled
props.description: Secondary text, leading icon, disabled option.

inherits: Props of react-aria-components ListBox (aria-label required without a visible label).

keyboard.action: Extends the selection in multiple mode.

accessibility: role="listbox" with aria-selected; selected options also show a check mark (not just color).
responsive: Fluid width; rows wrap with long text.
commonMistakes: Using ListBox as an action menu.
Omitting textValue when the option content is not plain text.
limits: No virtualization: designed for moderately sized lists.
